name: Zalaapáti (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaapáti (a blue shield with a tree, a bunch of grapes and a sheaf of grain, within a green wreath) above the name Zalaapáti in black script.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
